en.title: Two Checks, Two Questions

cards.label: STEP 1 · AT CHECK-IN
cards.heading: The airline
cards.sub: Will you be refused on arrival?

cards.label: STEP 2 · ON ARRIVAL
cards.heading: The border
cards.sub: Do you meet the entry conditions?

items.text: May ask how you will leave

en.focal: Usually counts: a booked ticket out
en.alt: Sketchnote comparing the airline check at check-in, which applies the destination's rules and decides whether you board, with the border check on arrival, which decides whether you enter
en.caption: The airline checks before you board; the border officer decides on arrival.
